The office has raised objection regarding the maintainability of this petition as the accused has already approached this Court in Crl.P.No.6926/2020, seeking the very same relief as sought in this petition.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo seeking permission of this Court to withdrawn the petition.
3. The aforesaid memo is placed on record.
4. In the light of the memo, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
In view of disposal of petition, pending application/s, if any, stands disposed off, as no separate order is required.
